Profile

I am a PhD student in Artificial Intelligence at Woosong University, exploring the intersection of artificial intelligence, business, and innovation.

Today, my PhD allows me to bring together everything I've studied so far — language, business strategy, and technology — into one line of inquiry. My research interests focus on the use of AI in business management and its applications across different fields, particularly where technology can support innovation, decision-making, and sustainable business development.

Academic journey

  1. 1

    BA & MA, English Honours — India

    Built a strong foundation in communication, critical thinking, and analysis.

  2. 2

    Double Master's, Business Management & Technology — SolBridge International School of Business

    Introduced me to the relationship between business strategy, technology, and digital transformation.

  3. 3

    PhD, Artificial Intelligence — Woosong University

    Bringing these experiences together to study how AI can support business decision-making and innovation.

Research focus

My expertise lies in marketing and business development. I'm interested in how emerging AI technologies can transform the way organizations understand customers, develop strategies, create value, and respond to a rapidly changing business environment.

I'm particularly drawn to research that bridges the gap between technological possibility and meaningful business application — not only asking what AI can do, but how it can be used effectively, responsibly, and sustainably.

Why AI

AI is more than a technological advancement — it is becoming an important part of how the future of business and society is being shaped.

Studying AI lets me connect my background in business with emerging technology, and explore practical ways it can address real-world challenges.
